notes.title: Update 1.7.0 Orphanage Beta Access
notes.content:
Orphanage Beta Map included in Full Game for the purposed of public beta testing for bug reports and community suggestions.

Currently we are testing weather all required pickups can be picked up and delivered to ritual to complete game.

All feedback appreciated. Prizes to be won, included brand new game keys for top feedback contributions.

All Story Cinematic's Removed for Full Version. Achievements may or may not work. Localization still to be added. Various Polish still required.

This map is a complete different game play from the usual perspective of attacking demons. Currently you as priests who have no weapons, and you need to flee the enemy while looking for ritual items. Coupled with the atmosphere of the environment, this should be a scarier / creepier experience. 

Final boss yet to be inserted to focus on pickups. Thank for you interest and support.

notes.title: HALLOWEEN CONTENT IS BACK! NEW MAP DETAILS? TRICK OR TREAT?
notes.content:
HALLOWEEN EVENT
V 1.5.3 HALLOWEEN CONTENT UPDATE + FOV FIXED + COSTUME SELECT FIXED!
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41751083/1a7f4bb988071b83398fedde7758c1cade574cf8.jpg

We're delighted to announce that our Halloween Event is returning, running throughout Steam's Scream Festival. We've resurrected the Halloween decorations from last year to bring back that spooky ambiance to our maps, and three costumes from the previous event are making a comeback.
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41751083/7f6f9be7338ebd2af4e2e8a23d0c98f64a7c3882.jpg
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41751083/ee93ee96da6a457ce6f22839421b2d2ae2dd7daa.jpg

KEEP SHOWING US YOUR SUPPORT.
MAKE A QUICK REVIEW. THANK YOU!

We're thrilled to share an update with you just in time for Halloween. We have been diligently crafting a brand-new map in the background. This exciting addition takes you to the mysterious locale known as the Orphanage, and the best part is it's absolutely free of charge. To all of you who support us please make a review, it would mean the world to us.
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41751083/977b9091c7562d18299b95b1f06539f13345c9f3.jpg
New Environment The upcoming map will immerse you in the haunting atmosphere of a Russian Orphanage.
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41751083/1a837dfafee20bf082b79810b9fc3cb7302e9e88.jpg
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41751083/4cb625a82acc87814483d176b7acf1f228a0e272.jpg
Story
In the mysterious St. Vladimir Orphanage in Russia, a string of baffling disappearances plagues the innocent orphans. As a dedicated investigator sent to unravel the enigma, your mission is clear: to unearth the truth behind the vanishing children and to eradicate the malevolent demon responsible.
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41751083/4be32619531fbb507e48d6bae61b98a6aeaddacd.png
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41751083/9a809d3ef1dabec90ee6f9b89063c73e6bad54ae.jpg
Candle Interactions
In addition to your arsenal, there will be Interactive Candles. These candles can be ignited to facilitate the search for ritual items, but beware, for every candle lit heightens the presence of lurking demonic Ghost Nuns in the vicinity, and these spirits have the ability to extinguish them.
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41751083/659215fa221468d6109043ad3cc26bf74fd92ea8.jpg
Ritual Items
The map will be teeming with a multitude of ritual items, strategically placed in varying locations with each playthrough. This dynamic arrangement ensures an added layer of replayability to the game.
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41751083/3406e47b9b25afaa2dbfe702b5ed1f9f5b330555.jpg
Demonic Ghost Nuns
For this map, we've introduced three new formidable Demonic Ghost Nuns. First, there's "The Wandering," an elusive specter that's perpetually on the move, requiring you to maintain unwavering vigilance. Then, we have the "Realm Jumper" a cunning entity capable of swiftly transitioning between physical areas, making your expedition particularly challenging. Lastly, there's the "The Raging Nun,"
who becomes aggressive in the presence of to much light.  Each of these spirits is committed to thwarting your quest to locate the ritual items.
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41751083/db7f7e1eb5571ef416ec606e0e47999011f61de4.jpg
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41751083/f2031c87265fc747e883c0de69c92d03e9704c02.jpg
HAPPY HALLOWEEN FROM THE DEV TEAM!
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41751083/a973c4a700fa5efbd99e08c6ba13ae3cd0e8d644.jpg

notes.title: NEW MAP BIBLE CAMP RELEASED!
notes.content:
We're happy to announce that Holy Purge Exorcist brand New Map Bible Camp is Now Available to play for FREE! Keep in mind there is only two dev's working on this, if you run into issues let us know. We will fix issues asap. This is by far the most ambitious game play design we have made so far. Hope you like it. Do let us know how we can make it 10x more scarier!

BIBLE CAMP MAP RELEASED PLAY NOW!
Launch trailer...
[previewyoutube=QhwU10UEgeM;full][/previewyoutube]

BIBLE CAMP - NEW MAP DETAILS
As you may already know, the new map takes place in a remote bible camp lake cabin resort. A terrible incident occurred which left the place abandoned.
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41751083/1a19b3af79f0f74ca4b92f89b16bcfb626be86c3.png
Players will get 2 New Priest Outfits inspired by Midnight Mass Series for FREE!
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41751083/58e2c7ce72e6dfcfe3df17ccdcf9950f09f7615c.png
Players will have 2 new weapons to deal with the possessed and the demons just waiting to feast on your teams souls. The first weapon The Bible when summoned will temporarily exorcise the feral children who were lost and abandoned deep in the forest from the demonic spirits that possessed them.
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41751083/6637dc0b0dff899647e993e048d6f4eed39a614f.jpg
The second weapon is The Orthodox Cross. This is a much more powerful weapon when compared to earlier crosses used. But requires patience with the lord to regain the lords favor. Be careful and wise to used such power, it may be the difference between life and death.
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41751083/f1bee2f8c03bd4ce743f7be849e292a3a1a72b38.jpg
Once a feral child has been acquired, your team will need to take it to one of the spiritual ritual pulpits spread across the area. You will need to read sermons while the demons attempt to stop you. It will not be easy, may the lord be with you.
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41751083/5e972016f29a29be3d6e0b58694c4dc1be26e608.jpg
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41751083/0da988bb0524823f3c508b5190b6bc952bcf3845.jpg
There are many types of demons in this map, ranging from ground runners, to Jumpers, and of course the Flying one. I suggest your teams prepare for this encounter , and fight off the reaper and werewolves in the village, and then exorcist the possessed demonic daughter before embarking on such a dangerous endeavor. Good luck and may god bless you all!
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41751083/c30ef8b33f6a6279602fc80bf584cade317a1fe5.jpg
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41751083/e53244a9b4eff76d88589e2fbf1b70adfcde564a.jpg

Currently we have 7 NEW ACHIEVEMENTS for Bible Camp! GO GET THEM!

All the difficulty levels are the same for bible camp. We will have an update by the weekend and it will makes the game terrifying on harder difficulty! I forbid your teams to be tempted to fight evil on these levels! Only the most experienced elite priests should try!

PLEASE SUPPORT US WITH REVIEW IF YOU WANT US TO MAKE MORE CONTENT! THANKS! HAVE FUN!
